```yaml
name: Test Flake

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'flake.nix'
      - 'flake.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/test-flake.yml'
      - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'flake.nix'
      - 'flake.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/test-flake.yml'
      - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.toml'
      - '**/Cargo.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-flake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable.latest.default
          components: rust-src, clippy, rustfmt

      - name: Run nix flake check
        run: nix flake check --print-build-logs

      - name: Initialize dev shell
        run: nix develop .#devshell

      - name: Run tests in dev shell
        run: cargo test
        env:
          RUST_BACKTRACE: full

    continue-on-error: true
```
